explanation: budget ran out; patch taken from the edits made

comparison.summary: The agent patch adds a conditional check to only return success when a specific login is provided or a matching login was found, and sets retcode to NETRC_FILE_MISSING when no matching login exists. The upstream patch completely rewrites the netrc parser with a new lexer-based approach, adding proper tokenization, quoted string handling, and a scanner state machine for more robust parsing.
comparison.agent_patch_risks: The agent patch only addresses the symptom (returning success when no matching login is found) without fixing the underlying parser issues. It misses the upstream's improvements: proper handling of quoted tokens with escape sequences, case-insensitive keyword matching, default entry support, macdef parsing, file size limits, and comprehensive syntax error detection. The agent patch could also break existing behavior for default entries and macdef sections.
